title: RAW Hippocratic I.13–15: age, fasting endurance and nourishment
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Three complete consecutive aphorisms constrain the relationship among age, endogenous heat, fasting and feeding, including a seasonal claim that blocks an easy outside-temperature gloss.

source.checked: Francis Adams translation read at the MIT Classics Archive.
source.content: Fasting endurance is ranked by age. Growing bodies require more nourishment; old bodies less. Winter and Spring are separately said to entail stronger internal heat and greater food need.

design.whole_passage_relation: Complete target account must preserve the age comparison, causal explanation, old-age fever qualification and seasonal comparison. It cannot reduce the source to four age labels.
two_reused_input_cases: Growing and old bodies repeat the nourishment/heat relation with different requirements.
Winter/Spring repeat that relation under season change, without equating ambient cold with low internal heat.
design.rival: A simple external-weather scale determines food need; age figures merely label seasons.
design.distinct_consequence: An internal-heat predicate must keep its denotation when applied to body age and seasonal physiology; cold weather need not imply low internal heat.
design.falsifier: Fail if a same-form heat or food predicate must switch from internal to external meaning to complete all three aphorisms, or if the age-ranking clause reverses under the unchanged comparator.
design.smallest_step: Author the three complete assertions with one comparison and one causal operator, then bind them to a complete declared target block-set without deleting qualifications.
new_costs: Age stages and season episodes are separate arguments; no unstated calorie amounts.
Historic feeding/fasting claims are source content, not advice.
predecessors: First-batch532 only proposed constitution/environment separation; this adds a definite three-aphorism hierarchy and causal cross-check rather than re-registering that abstract question.
design.main_gap: The entire connected content is not yet assigned to target words; the age/season double-use remains a hypothesis.

duplicate_screen.limit: Common-design vocabulary dominated ranking. Targeted source searches and predecessor primary reads above provide navigation; no novelty certification.
